python - <<'PY'
from math import gcd
from more_itertools import all_equal, totient
assert all_equal('aAaA', key=str.casefold) is True
assert all_equal('aAb', key=str.casefold) is False
assert all_equal([], key=lambda x: 1 / 0) is True
assert all_equal([[1], [1]], key=lambda x: x) is True
assert all_equal([[1], [2]], key=lambda x: x) is False
assert all_equal([0, 2, 4], key=lambda x: x % 2) is True
assert all_equal([0, 2, 3], key=lambda x: x % 2) is False
for n in range(1, 1001):
    assert totient(n) == sum(gcd(n, k) == 1 for k in range(1, n + 1)), n
print('Key-based comparisons and totients for 1..1000 passed')
PY
